name: Los Angeles International Airport

runway.v: four runways; the longest, 07L/25R, is 12,923 ft x 150 ft (about 3,939 m x 46 m); 07R/25L 11,095 x 200 ft, 06R/24L 10,885 x 150 ft, 06L/24R 8,926 x 150 ft

hours.v: airport attended all months, all days, all hours (24 hours); no curfew is stated in the FAA AIP or on LAWA's noise page
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

noise.v: from midnight to 06:30 local all arrivals approach from over the ocean (unless ATC finds it unsafe); 22:00-07:00 ATC maximises use of the inner runways; no turns on westerly take-offs before crossing the shoreline; mounted engine run-ups banned 23:00-06:00
noise.quote: From midnight to 6:30 a.m., all aircraft arriving at LAX must approach from over the ocean.

customs.v: CBP general aviation service 7 days a week, 07:00-23:00 Pacific Time; permission to land must be obtained before leaving the foreign airport, valid +/-15 minutes of the ETA; all crew and passengers processed in the FIS facility, which is not connected to the main terminal

ppr.v: for international arrivals, CBP permission to land before departure from the foreign airport
ppr.quote: Pilots must secure permission to land by contacting CBP prior to departure from the foreign port or place.

slots.v: IATA Level 2 (schedule-facilitated) airport; FAA reviews scheduled and other regularly conducted commercial operations 06:00-23:00 Pacific Time (13:00-06:00 UTC in summer); Summer 2027 season 28 Mar-30 Oct 2027. Ad hoc charter is not named
slots.quote: FAA has designated EWR, LAX, ORD, and SFO as IATA Level 2 airports

notes: Runways, hours and fuel from the FAA US AIP Part 3 AD 2 California page (no edition date shown; read today). The AIP also says 'OVER-OCEAN APCHS UTILIZED 0000-0630'. No curfew is stated anywhere read, but no source says outright that there is none, so curfew is left missing. CBP fact sheet dated 15 Feb 2024 (KLAX-0224). Slots from the Federal Register notice of 9 Oct 2026; the 13:00-06:00 UTC figure there is for summer (PDT); in winter 06:00-23:00 PT is 14:00-07:00 UTC. IATA code LAX as written in that notice. FAA Chart Supplement could not be opened.
